_about: TODO 300 — what each firearm's picture should look like, in our own words (never book text). 'look' names a real-world gun or describes the form; 'tech': true draws it as high-tech sci-fi, else as a modern-day firearm. Smartgun LEDs are added from the pack data, not here. Drafted 2026-11-13 for the maintainer's review; exotics checked against the book pages in side-session-notes/weapon-art-exotics-checked.md.
